entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A male human planeswalker born in Tidehollow on Esper, a master artificer who manipulates metal and serves many multiversal evils while pursuing his own goals.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker who recruited Tezzeret into the Infinite Consortium and was betrayed and eventually killed.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepathic planeswalker groomed by Tezzeret as his ace against Bolas, later his enemy.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and Jace's lover who fought Tezzeret and helped Bolas regain the Consortium.

entities.name: Silas Renn
entities.description: A seeker-adept who defeated Tezzeret in a duel and was his rival.

entities.name: Amalex Pannet
entities.description: The headmaster of the Vectis City Academy, murdered by Tezzeret to cover his expulsion.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: A sphinx whose teachings were said to be in the Codex Etherium.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: A covert operation run by Bolas that Tezzeret took over and which fell when Jace defeated him.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: An Esper sect of artificers that rejected Tezzeret and was massacred by him.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers who opposed Tezzeret on Kaladesh and in the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: Baltrice
entities.description: Tezzeret's second in command, who tortured Jace and later assisted Jace.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who presented Tezzeret to Karn, experimented on Tamiyo and forged Tezzeret's darksteel body.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The Father of Machines whom Tezzeret served on Mirrodin and later oversaw the disassembly of.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Phyrexian who sat beside Karn and fought Tezzeret.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The praetor who promised Tezzeret an indestructible darksteel body in exchange for service.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: The rebel praetor whom Tezzeret supported against Norn.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An elven inventor crowned winner of the Inventors' Fair whose portal Tezzeret claimed as his own.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: The Renegade Prime of Ghirapur whom Tezzeret fought in a quicksmithing match.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who attacked Tezzeret on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A vedalken who served Tezzeret during the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker assigned to hunt Tezzeret down after the War of the Spark and who was beaten by him.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker who tracked Tezzeret with Ral, fearing what he might become.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A Dimir shapeshifter who formed a secret alliance with Tezzeret.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A planeswalker who gloatingly told Tezzeret that Bolas was dead.

entities.name: Brokk
entities.description: A gargoyle minion of Tezzeret and leader of his etherium gargoyles.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker Tezzeret abducted for Jin-Gitaxias and who was compleated.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's adopted son who ambushed Tezzeret on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Estel
entities.description: A street urchin of Tidehollow Tezzeret tasked with carrying a message to Rafiq.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: A wildcat scavenger who with Tannuk recovered the Endstone for Tezzeret.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: A wildcat scavenger who with Sami recovered the Endstone for Tezzeret.

entities.name: Isona Maive
entities.description: A character Tezzeret used to amplify aether magic; she dampened his connection.

entities.name: Davriel Cane
entities.description: A planeswalker who broke Tezzeret's interplanar machine and freed Isona.

entities.name: Sharuum
entities.description: The Grand Hegemon of Esper who gave Tezzeret riddles to find Crucius.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: A portal device whose core Tezzeret fused into his body; it could open interplanar portals but was slowly destroying him.

entities.name: Endstone
entities.description: An item from Sigma's Reach with the power to manipulate causality.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The Alara shard where Tezzeret was born and where his fortress stands.

entities.name: Tidehollow
entities.description: The Esper slum where Tezzeret grew up.

entities.name: Seekers' Sanctum
entities.description: The sanctum Tezzeret made his fortress in the clouds of Esper.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The Alara shard where Tezzeret awoke after his spark ignited.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane where Tezzeret experimented with the Reality Chip and fought Jace.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane where Tezzeret recruited Jace and plotted with Lazav.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane where Tezzeret infiltrated the Phyrexian hierarchy.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where Tezzeret became Head Judge and Grand Consul.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane Tezzeret revealed as Bolas's hiding place and used as the portal's other end.

entities.name: The Edge
entities.description: A region outside the Multiverse where Tezzeret built a criminal consortium.

entities.name: Metal Island
entities.description: A pocket plane where Tezzeret confronted Bolas.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The Alara shard where Tezzeret awoke in the Worldheart Chalice.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker Tezzeret intercepted on New Capenna to introduce to Urabrask.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A Phyrexian-aligned character whose attack on Urza's Tower Tezzeret joined and from which he retrieved her.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The metropolis on Capenna where Tezzeret met Vivien Reid with Urabrask.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Tezzeret joined Rona's attack on Urza's Tower.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane Tezzeret allied with and served for a darksteel body.

events.summary: As a boy Tezzeret is named for his first act of calculated violence, stabbing an older bully.
events.quote: He received this name after his first act of calculated violence, stabbing an older boy who had bullied him

events.summary: Tezzeret's mother dies and his father teaches him that the strong rule; Tezzeret vows to become a mage.
events.quote: the day his mother died

events.summary: At eleven Tezzeret flees Tidehollow with stolen etherium hidden beneath his skin and hair.
events.quote: Tezzeret fled Tidehollow, leaving his father to whatever life the old man could make for himself

events.summary: Tezzeret apprentices to an artificer and later joins the Mechanists' Guild.
events.quote: Tezzeret apprenticed to an artificer immediately after leaving the cesspools of the Tidehollow

events.summary: At 19 Tezzeret replaces his right arm with solid etherium.
events.quote: At the age of 19, Tezzeret performed the ritual that severed his right arm and replaced it with a solid etherium arm

events.summary: The guildmasters elevate Tezzeret to master status and he goes to the Academy of the Seekers.
events.quote: the guildmasters immediately elevated him to master status

events.summary: Learning he is to be expelled from the Academy, Tezzeret murders Headmaster Pannet.
events.quote: To cover his expulsion, he murdered Pannet and continued his training unabated

events.summary: Tezzeret breaks into the vault, finds the Codex Etherium a fraud, is beaten and his spark ignites.
events.quote: accidentally triggering his spark in the act

events.summary: Tezzeret awakes on Grixis after planeswalking blindly through the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: he awoke to find himself on Grixis

events.summary: Tezzeret reaches Nicol Bolas, who promises power in exchange for servitude.
events.quote: who promised him power in exchange for servitude

events.summary: Tezzeret assassinates the Consortium's cell leaders and takes over its leadership from Bolas.
events.quote: he orchestrated the assassination of all high-positioned cell leaders who were directly subordinated only to Bolas

events.summary: Tezzeret massacres the Seekers on Esper, sparing only Silas Renn who was absent.
events.quote: he murdered the entire sect, eliminating the new Hieresiarch and the whole Arcane Council

events.summary: Allied with New Phyrexia, Tezzeret tries to control Kyodai with a prototype Reality Chip and accidentally ignites the Emperor's spark.
events.quote: he accidentally ignited the Emperor of Kamigawa

events.summary: Tezzeret recruits Jace to the Consortium on Ravnica.
events.quote: Tezzeret sought out Jace Beleren to join the Consortium on Ravnica

events.summary: Bolas betrays Tezzeret and Jace, hiring mercenaries to hunt them.
events.quote: He betrayed each of them, having hired a troop of barbarian mercenaries to hunt the pair

events.summary: Tezzeret captures Jace and has Baltrice torture him.
events.quote: Tezzeret captured Jace

events.summary: Jace defeats Tezzeret on Kamigawa, obliterating his mind and causing the Fall of the Infinite Consortium.
events.quote: Tezzeret lost this duel against Jace after they planeswalked to Kamigawa

events.summary: Jace amputates Tezzeret's etherium arm with the manablade.
events.quote: he lost his etherium arm when Jace amputated it with his manablade

events.summary: Tezzeret is left brain-dead for ratfolk to find, and Bolas later takes his body.
events.quote: Tezzeret was left brain-dead in the burned village for the ratfolk to find

events.summary: Restored by Bolas, Tezzeret obeys only when Bolas arrives in person.
events.quote: Only when Bolas personally arrived to reprimand his servant did Tezzeret obey

events.summary: On Mirrodin Tezzeret infiltrates the Phyrexian hierarchy, immune to phyresis, rising to sit beside Karn.
events.quote: Tezzeret established himself within the Phyrexian hierarchy without the compromise of undergoing compleation

events.summary: Tezzeret fights Glissa while plotting to usurp Karn's throne; the outcome is unknown.
events.quote: This resulted in direct combat with Glissa

events.summary: Tezzeret reports to Bolas that the New Phyrexians had not yet attained interplanar travel.
events.quote: Tezzeret reported to Bolas that the New Phyrexians had not yet attained interplanar travel

events.summary: On Kaladesh Tezzeret becomes Head Judge and identifies Pia Nalaar as the Renegade Prime.
events.quote: He identified Pia Nalaar as the Renegade Prime of Ghirapur

events.summary: Tezzeret nearly kills Pia but Chandra attacks and the Gatewatch appears; he retreats into the Skysovereign.
events.quote: Tezzeret nearly killed Pia, but was attacked by Chandra Nalaar before he could

events.summary: During the Aether Revolt Tezzeret is declared Grand Consul with emergency powers.
events.quote: Tezzeret was granted emergency powers and declared Grand Consul

events.summary: Tezzeret dismisses Rashmi, claiming her invention as his own.
events.quote: Tezzeret dismissed her, claiming her invention as his own

events.summary: Liliana overwhelms Tezzeret at the Planar Bridge; he escapes with the portal's core after Chandra and Gideon crash into it.
events.quote: However, Tezzeret managed to escape with the core of the portal intact

events.summary: Tezzeret places a device on Lavinia's neck, letting Bolas possess her to kill Hekara.
events.quote: She had become possessed after Tezzeret had placed a device on her neck

events.summary: Tezzeret serves as the conduit from Amonkhet to Ravnica for the Eternal Dreadhorde.
events.quote: he could function as the conduit from Amonkhet to Ravnica for the invasion of the Eternal Dreadhorde

events.summary: Karn, Dack, Ob Nixilis and Samut collapse the portal in Tezzeret's chest; he seals the hole and planeswalks away.
events.quote: Before they could react, he planeswalked away

events.summary: Ral Zarek is assigned to track down and kill Tezzeret after the War.
events.quote: Ral Zarek was assigned to track him down and kill him

events.summary: Tezzeret flees to Esper and learns from Tibalt that Bolas is dead.
events.quote: Tezzeret fled to Esper on Alara

events.summary: Tezzeret beats Ral in hand-to-hand combat and gives him his damaged arm as proof of the kill.
events.quote: Tezzeret showed mercy and gave Ral his damaged etherium arm to provide proof of the kill

events.summary: Tezzeret meets Lazav, with whom he has a secret alliance.
events.quote: Tezzeret returned to Ravnica to meet with Lazav

events.summary: Seeking a new body, Tezzeret allies with New Phyrexia while secretly backing Urabrask and alerting the Gatewatch.
events.quote: he simultaneously supported the rebel praetor Urabrask and discreetly alerted the Gatewatch through trusted intermediaries

events.summary: Tezzeret abducts Tamiyo and is complicit in her compleation.
events.quote: he was complicit to the compleation of Tamiyo

events.summary: Tezzeret intercepts Vivien Reid on New Capenna to introduce her to Urabrask.
events.quote: he intercepted Vivien Reid

events.summary: Tezzeret oversees Karn's disassembly and reveals to him that he is not truly loyal to New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Tezzeret returned to New Phyrexia and oversaw the disassembly of Karn

events.summary: Tezzeret retrieves a defeated Rona at Urza's Tower rather than executing wounded planeswalkers.
events.quote: Tezzeret merely retrieved a defeated Rona and delivered a warning

events.summary: Norn keeps her bargain and Jin-Gitaxias forges Tezzeret a darksteel body, then tries to bind him.
events.quote: she ultimately held up her bargain, instructing Jin-Gitaxias to forge Tezzeret a darksteel body

events.summary: Tezzeret escapes Jin-Gitaxias by controlling a prisoner with Esper mind magic.
events.quote: Tezzeret used an Esper mentalist power to control an unfortunate prisoner

events.summary: Tezzeret sends Estel to warn Rafiq as Phyrexians assault Alara.
events.quote: he tasked a street urchin named Estel to deliver a message to Rafiq

events.summary: After the invasion Tezzeret ends up on the Edge and builds a criminal consortium.
events.quote: Tezzeret somehow traveled to the Edge

events.summary: Sami and Tannuk recover the Endstone for Tezzeret.
events.quote: Sami and Tannuk recovered the Endstone

events.summary: Tezzeret awakes on Jund, restored by Bolas, who sends him to find Crucius.
events.quote: Tezzeret awoke on Jund, in the Worldheart Chalice

events.summary: Tezzeret agrees to Sharuum's proposal and receives two riddles from Crucius.
events.quote: Tezzeret agreed to her proposal

events.summary: Tezzeret empowers himself with sangrite and defeats Silas Renn at the Crystal Labyrinth.
events.quote: which he used to teleport directly to the Labyrinth and defeat Renn horribly

events.summary: On the Metal Island Tezzeret engineers a fight in which Bolas is weakened and leaves him trapped.
events.quote: Tezzeret himself left Bolas trapped on the island

events.summary: Davriel frees Isona, who dampens Tezzeret's aether connection, and planeswalkers leave him a statue.
events.quote: They left him as a statue in his laboratory
